comments.text: From: GC. Investigation done (survey on 807cf8e1d): the captures' kind test is CaptureStores::store_open_ref_word (closure.rs, StoredRefKind::Open), the slot-naming scalar ref of kinds 0xA..=0xE; fz-9x7.44.8 removes it (capture store becomes str + strb) and .44.8 cannot land partly, so it leaves this ticket.
